title: BatchObservations
description: The deterministic artifact overwritten by `dmtool batch <ops.json> --observations <file>`. It retains static real-kernel candidate outcomes as diagnostic codes only: no summaries, authored inputs, arguments, timings, paths, locale-dependent text, host data, interpreter runtime values, qualification, or projector data. Every child needs an id and must be `rule check --condition ...`, `computation add <spec> --dry-run`, or `computation modify ... --spec <spec> --dry-run`; observation capture never persists a computation candidate. The inputHash identifies the authored candidate using the version 2 framing described on that property; it includes rule messages and computation targets. Model and workspace dependency contents are not part of inputHash. The optional model is SHA-256 of the one effective persisted model file and is omitted for a heterogeneous/no-model batch. The two axes are independent, in BOTH directions: a rule-check verdict rejects a candidate with ok:true and valid:false, while a kernel-gated computation dry-run the kernel refuses reports ok:false and valid:false — ok is execution success, valid is the kernel verdict. valid appears only when the child emitted one, so a child that failed to run is ok:false with no valid at all.

schemaVersion.description: integer artifact contract version; version 2 replaces condition/spec-only hashes with framed candidate hashes, so hashes are not comparable with version 1

kernelBuilt.description: kernel version built against, exactly manifest.version.kernel.builtAgainst

kernelRuntime.description: kernel version on the runtime classpath, exactly manifest.version.kernel.runtime

model.description: optional SHA-256 of the one effective model's persisted bytes after dispatch; omitted when there is no single model identity

observations.description: one compact result per child in dispatch order

id.description: the caller's batch item tag, verbatim

inputHash.description: SHA-256 of a sequence of length-prefixed byte strings: each length is a signed 32-bit big-endian integer, -1 means absent, otherwise that many bytes follow. Text is UTF-8 without normalization. First: `dmtool-observation-input-v2`, then the canonical verb. For rule check: --condition, --field, --group (absent stays absent), --code, --severity (parser default ERROR), --name (parser default CheckRule), then each effective --message locale and text pair in Java String natural locale-key order. Duplicate locales use the parser's last value. For computation add: exact spec-file bytes. For computation modify: computation path, then exact spec-file bytes. Caller id, filesystem paths, output options, model bytes, and workspace dependencies are excluded; model identity is separate. This is authored-candidate identity, not a complete environment or replay payload.

ok.description: the child's execution-success axis; independent of valid

valid.description: the child's kernel verdict, present only when the invocation emitted one

codes.description: diagnostic code values in emitted kernel order; never summaries
